elements.label: Mouse cursor travels from the text area up to the community link (I-beam to pointer)
Community link underlines on hover
elements.text: Visit our community to learn tips, best practices and FAQ.

pattern.description: Screen recording: the cursor glides up from the feedback text area to the 'community' link, which underlines on hover, pointing the viewer to the community resource as the narration wraps up.
pattern.why_premium: The cursor acts as a pointer for the viewer's eye, landing on the exact link the closing line is about to reference.

build_hint.remotion: cursor position = interpolate(frame, [0, 11], [start, end], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); swap cursor icon and underline the link when frame >= 11 (step).

notes: Only cursor movement and a hover underline; dialog itself is static. Cursor deltas in build_hint are approximate.
